name: Saudi Awwal Bank
summary: Saudi Awwal Bank, together with its subsidiaries, provides banking and financial services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Wealth & Personal Banking, Corporate and Institutional Banking, Treasury, Capital Markets, and Others segments. It offers personal and business savings, current, commodity investment, wafer accounts, and green deposit account; personal and home financing; credit, debit, business, and prepaid cards; wealth management solutions; investment solutions; payments and transfer services; e-statement, treasury, and private banking services; safe deposit lockers; and online, mobile, and phone banking services.
